action_summary: Six passes of capability audit plus a no-model propagation loop. The audit answers one question with measured evidence: which capabilities exist, who executes each, and who wins. It corrected itself five times, each edition naming what the last got wrong. The zipper repaired a real 9-hop rename and cleared four corpus rows byte-identically.
expected_parent_change: canonical/verification/ gains audit documents; canonical/tools/ gains measured tools; canonical/tests/ gains pinned tests; identify_a_real_bugs_fix_v1.py gains a provenance guard.
expected_parent_frontier_change: The capability inventory stops being a set of branch self-claims and becomes a measured census: 2238 runtime modules tiered into 1190 production-imported, 836 test-only and 212 orphan; 19 capability families each routed to a named executor; 595 public-runner verifications each checked for capability credit. The frontier verdict is stated per capability in the same row as the losing margin.
explicit_user_authorization: Owner instruction this session, repeated four times, then 'merge all of your work.' The repetition is the authorization: earlier answers had sampled and the owner required a measured census, and required it landed in main.
falsification_condition: FALSIFIED if any cited capability number rests on a branch self-claim rather than a receipt, or if any capability marked OWNED routes through a model or external service.
measured_effect: 3.9% SWE-bench Verified vs 76.8% frontier; 2/89 blind real commits vs 0 baseline; 6/11 Terminal-Bench self-selected vs 82.7%; 0/10 global ASTRA predicates with 51/51 non-global; 0 of 595 public-runner verifications carry credit; 15 of 19 families route through an external model. Four corpus rows cleared byte-identically.

obs_capability.existing_inherited_routes_checked: The ledger, the 11 specs, the 19-family audit, astra closure JSONs, 321 missions and the 595 public-runner receipts were all read as existing routes.
obs_capability.external_existing_routes_checked: Frontier numbers were taken from published harness results for SWE-bench Verified, Terminal-Bench 2.0, OSWorld-Verified, GAIA and HLE rather than re-measured.
obs_capability.surviving_gap: No mechanism existed to produce a fix for a repository the system had never seen; the propagation loop fills only the narrow part of that gap that error text can express.

recursive_obs.real_outcome: A per-capability frontier verdict grounded in receipts, plus a no-model propagation loop that repairs real renames.

route_frontier.not_applicable_reason: EVIDENCE_PRESERVATION: this action records measurements already made and spends nothing on a route, so there is no challenger route to discover before execution.

recursive_obs.selected_surviving_route: REUSE existing receipts, then AST-scan every module, then compose the frontier comparison from published harness results.
recursive_obs.stop_condition: STOP when every capability family has a named executor and a frontier verdict with its margin, when every branch in the union of refs has been read rather than sampled, and when the answer to whether these are all of them is a measured count with its residual tier stated instead of an assertion. Achieved: the residual is 836 test-only plus 212 orphan modules, named and counted, and full coverage is reported as structurally unavailable.
recursive_obs.why_selected_route_is_fastest_sufficient: It answers the question from artifacts already on disk and a published baseline, with no frontier spend, and it is falsifiable because every number carries a path.
